job.description:

Regional Workforce Management (RWM) is proudly Australian-owned, dedicated to connecting businesses with tailored recruitment and workforce management solutions since 2000. Formerly FIP Group, we’ve spent over two decades supporting the backbone of Australia - the food, agriculture, forestry and fisheries industries. What started as a small operation helping local businesses quickly grew into something much bigger. We are seeking a Site Manager to work onsite at one of our client's locations, Charleville.

To be successful in this role you will have a drive to deliver and be a highly organised individual. You will be passionate about helping others succeed and be committed to this role. 

You will also:

  • Administration/HR/payroll experience is highly desirable
  • Have a Drivers licence and vehicle
  • Be willing to obtain a Police Check
  • Be vaccinated against against COVID-19
  • Be willing and able to be vaccinated against QFever
If this sounds like you, APPLY NOW!

Please note only successful applicants will be contacted.

job.title: First Aid & Administration Officer
job.description:

We are seeking a First Aid & Administration Officer for our client who is a leading Australian-owned beef processing company. In this role you will be supporting the Safety team by providing frontline first aid assistance, employee wellbeing support, RTW coordination, and general administration within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Full-time | Casual, opportunity to transition to permanent
  • Flexible shift options available
  • Pay rate: $33.47 - $40.80 per hour 
  • Located in Moe, VIC
Roles & Responsibilities:
Within this role you will be required to preform a range of administration and First aid tasks including but not limited to:
  • Provide general administrative support to site management and supervisors.

  • Maintain employee records, files, registers and documentation.
  • Enter data accurately into company systems and spreadsheets.
  • Order and maintain office and site supplies.
  • Prepare reports, documents and correspondence as required.
  • Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.
  • Maintain first aid rooms, kits and equipment and ensure supplies are adequately stocked.
